items: AI succeeds in Southeast Asia when it understands local context, from regional languages and dialects to cash payments, patchy connectivity and dense city traffic.
Models trained mainly on Western content struggle with the region's many languages, so businesses are turning to AI trained on Malay, Vietnamese, Thai, Khmer and other local content.
Most people go online by mobile, so AI works best inside everyday formats like WhatsApp ordering, QR code menus and voice bots for call-in orders.
If you're building AI in the region, think local first, design for low bandwidth, be open about your training data and work with local partners.
